def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    # Normalize bin loads to [0, 1] range
    normalized_load = (bins - remaining) / (bins + 1e-9)
    # Penalize bins that are too empty or too full; reward those at moderate load
    # Use a Gaussian-like penalty centered around 0.5 (half-full)
    deviation_from_center = np.abs(normalized_load - 0.5)
    # Prioritize bins with load closest to half-full
    priorities = 1 / (deviation_from_center + 1e-9)
    # Set priority to 0 if bin cannot accept the item
    priorities[remaining == 0] = 0
    return priorities
